parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path per the restraint rules, regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The production copy of 'DebugMetricsProvider.setUpTimers' resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel); the WallpaperSampleApp copy in 'DebugHUD.swift' (package: Wallpaper) is a demonstration fixture that intentionally mirrors the production behaviour locally. Consolidating these would couple the DebugPanel production package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
